source: Simulated defaults from FyberLabs/market-sim (seed 5547) and the 2026-09-25 pricing memos. Not measured Fyber prices, utilization, or revenue. The platform fee (take) is not set here.

changelog.summary: Initial published ruleset. No previous version.

lines: Prices move at most 2.5% per 15 minutes
Prices step toward the pool being 70% busy
When the recent day-ahead price is higher, the cap is 1.5x that price
Priority tip capped at 10% of the live price
New or quiet pools get up to a 1.3x floor boost that fades as the pool reaches 55% busy
The full boost holds while the pool is at or below 35% busy
The quiet-pool boost uses the last 24 hours of real-time use
No org may take more than 25% of a scarce pool
At most 75% of offered hours are sold a day ahead
A pool with fewer than 3 hosts is priced at its reserve
Hardware cost in the floor is spread over 3 years, assuming the machine is busy between 30% and 70% of the time
When utilization is not supplied, the floor assumes 50% busy
A day-ahead award can move up to a higher choice when the cleared price allows it
